title: AI Agent vs Chatbot: A Real Trip Planning Task
description: A chat reply is not the same as a finished task. Follow a half-day Taipei itinerary built from public information, see how a lookup changes the next step, and learn how to check the handoff. The demonstration lookup was performed on September 27, 2026. Check the museum's latest notice before visiting.
